title: "Market Analyst Filters & Export — A-01"

As a Market Analyst, I want filters and exports so I can prioritize opportunities by market signals.

Acceptance criteria:
- Filter UI supports tags, trend, effort, and date ranges.
- CSV export for selected rows and columns.
- Saved filter presets for repeated use.
